purpose: Locate time spent in palette admission, selection construction, selection algorithm, encoding, transfer and decoding before another product change.

harvest.source: same protected interrupted LLVM source snapshot as reply-admission
harvest.profiling: existing EGGSHELL_TRACE_SERVICE_PROFILE=1 receipts; observer overhead included, no speedup claims
harvest.savedReplayInput: Only original source heads, owner IDs, logical selector JSON and expected choice JSON. No Access, SourceReference, Endpoint or capability is serialized.
harvest.fixtureUse: Necessary public LLVM test input for subsequent deterministic replay, not a retained DB/cache/archive.

replay.oracle: Exact original hook choice, not a human-required-code selector.
replay.limits: Existing 29 s requests and all existing service byte/view limits; no increase.
replay.nativeSampling: At the 80-client diagnostic only, sample the owned publisher for four seconds using macOS sample. This is observability with overhead, not a performance adoption comparison.
